text:
Aisha (People Ops): Heads up — we're scheduling the mandatory annual Compliance & Data Handling training next month. We need to run multiple live sessions across APAC/EMEA/NA so folks can attend in their local business hours. Please reply with your preferred session window (morning/afternoon) and any accessibility or timezone constraints by EOD Fri.

Mateo G: Morning APAC preferred (UTC+8). If only one APAC slot, prefer 9–11am local. Also need captioning for hearing-impaired folks.

Jin W: Afternoon EMEA works for me (UTC+1). Can we get an async recording + quiz? I travel a lot.

Priya R: NA east prefers afternoon (EST). Managers will need a completion report.

Sofia (Legal): Reminder — training must include section on EU data subject rights. Also need translations for French/German by launch.

onboarding-bot: New calendar event created: Compliance Training - sign up here https://rwd.co/training-signup :calendar:

Aisha (People Ops): Quick clarifications — we'll run 3 live windows: APAC morning, EMEA afternoon, NA late morning/early afternoon. There will be a 45-min live session + 20-min Q&A. Recording + mandatory quiz will be posted 24h after session. Accessibility: captions + alt text for slides. If you need localized transcript or interpreter, DM me.

Mateo G: can we move APAC to 8:30–10am? avoids overlap with engineering syncs. Also cc'ing Facilities for room needs.

Facilities Team: @Mateo G for in-office rooms we have 3 panel rooms available 8:30–10am. Need headcount by 72h before.

Priya R: Managers — what's the expected reporting cadence? weekly until 95% completion?

Aisha (People Ops): Managers will get a tracker export we expect them to update weekly. Final cutoff 3 weeks after launch. We'll send a manager guide.

Sofia (Legal): Also add a short attestation step on the quiz for those handling PII.

Jin W: Sounds good. For async quiz, can it be open book? some compliance items are nuanced.

Aisha (People Ops): Yes open-book allowed. Quiz is to ensure awareness, not trap. Passing threshold 80%. We'll have a remediation flow for failures.

Mateo G: RSVP: I'll take 8:30–10am APAC, need captions + transcript.

onboarding-bot: RSVP recorded: Mateo G -> APAC morning 8:30. Total RSVPs: 12

Priya R: Managers: I'll send a short Slack template for nudges to teams after you get the tracker.

Aisha (People Ops): Deadline reminder: please submit localization requests (language + reason) by next Wed 11:59pm PST. After that we'll only do high-priority languages (French, German, Spanish).

Sofia (Legal): Approving priority list: French, German, Spanish. For other languages, require manager justification.

Jin W: Can we get the slide deck in plain text for screen readers?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes — we'll publish an accessible version. Thanks Jin.

Mateo G: Thanks. :thumbsup:
